$comment: Lightweight orchestration for pico-spatial-app-designer. The host LLM is the orchestrator; the only local Python gate is the linear design-spec surface and native-color discipline check, with no execution-trace receipts or status state machine. Reasoning is carried in design-doc.md; executable design facts are carried in design-spec.json and rendered into preview.html. Phases run in order; the critique-again phase drives a bounded JSON-first patch loop. It may run standalone for design-only work or as the mandatory design subworkflow of spatial-design-to-app.

icon_resolution.when: after component semantics are fixed and an explicit icon slot, icon-only action, or app-authored directional/status cue remains

custom_drawing.when: no higher-priority source accurately matches the required subject, state, direction, and treatment

invocation_contract.standalone: design, review, or repair a PICO Spatial app design package
invocation_contract.parent_trigger: the user supplied neither a visual asset nor an executable design package, including every one-line feature request
return_to_parent_when: every icon asset resolves and every sui-icon node has an assetId
every declared custom icon SVG exists and passed 24 dp drawing review
preview.html is rendered from an exact embedded design-spec.json snapshot
rendered visual quality passes at default and minimum surface sizes
returns: design-assets/icons/*.svg when custom icons are required
invocation_contract.on_failure: return a blocking result; the parent must not generate app code

phases.title: Frame
phases.does: Anchor subject (domain, viewer, room/posture, single job); justify space affordance-by-affordance with a 2D counterfactual for each core task, letting that justification pick the form and scale (Planar window of any size / HUD-Augment widget / Volumetric / Stage); capture assumptions with confidence.

phases.title: Explore
phases.does: Generate >=3 substantially different design directions, preferably via one fresh-context subagent per direction spawned in parallel (each seeded only with shared frame/job/spatial-justification/domain plus one divergence constraint, blind to the others); fall back to isolated inline generation if subagents are unavailable. Then, as orchestrator, discard near-duplicates, compare in a decision matrix, pick one, and record why the others lost.
phases.output: Three alternatives + decision matrix + chosen direction + rejection reasons

phases.title: Plan
phases.does: Plan a compact named system and settle component semantics first. Keep every layout and domain_visual region transparent, allow at most one bounded content fill on each root-to-content path, and declare no app-authored content borders or material fields. When a domain_visual has repeated or independently styled internal regions, declare optional node-local parts with base and state appearances; omit parts when no internal appearance boundary exists. Preserve every native SpatialUI ColorScheme role unchanged as its same-name Vibrant role; put custom colors only in app-owned brandColors. For each remaining explicit icon need, preserve user/Figma, app, or SDK assets; otherwise search the bundled ICON 7.0 catalog. Use an exact semantic match when available, and declare a design-assets/icons SVG drawing requirement when no candidate accurately matches. Then write and validate design-spec.json before any HTML, including scripts/check_design_surface_discipline.py. The JSON encodes the immutable 16-role ColorScheme references plus brand tokens, typography, signature, surfaces and dimensions, nodes and hierarchy, component props, initial state, state graph, transitions, local actions, normal/fallback/error data, assets, and responsive rules. The system window background remains runtime context and is not encoded as rootMaterial or appearance.material. design-doc.md retains rationale and summaries; design-spec.json owns executable values.

phases.title: Critique (before build)
phases.does: Simulate the generic-default output for this brief; check the plan for templated thinking; run originality and spatial hard checks; revise and note changes. Gate before building.

phases.title: Build
phases.does: Draw every declared custom icon as a reviewed 24 x 24 currentColor SVG under design-assets/icons, then build a single self-contained preview.html from design-spec.json. Resolve bundled icon70 assets to bundled SVG and custom icon assets to their exact generated SVG, embedding either as slotted content. Embed an exact JSON snapshot, inline the vendored SpatialUI Web bundle, parse the spec at runtime, keep its native Vibrant ColorScheme unchanged, expose custom brandColors separately, render its node graph and mapped sui-* controls, and drive state, transitions, confirmation, data cases, assets, and responsive behavior from the spec. Layout and domain_visual nodes remain transparent. App-authored CSS may apply fill only through the canonical [data-design-surface] rule backed by --pico-design-surface-fill; the renderer sets that attribute from the node ID and creates each filled node once. It must not infer backgrounds, radii, or borders from node names or layout modes, and must reject rootMaterial or appearance.material. Set the page body to the fixed light neutral #DAD6D3 preview environment with no background image; this renderer-owned context is not a design-spec.json value or app-owned color. Product markup is only a mount point; renderer code must not introduce independent design facts.
phases.output: preview.html rendered from design-spec.json + coverage manifest

phases.title: Critique again
phases.does: Independently rebuild coverage from design-spec.json; verify schema validity, surface-discipline check success, exact external/embedded JSON parity, absence of HTML-only design facts, and implementation of every state, transition, component, binding, asset, and responsive rule. Audit source-priority evidence for every icon, bundled icon70 URI resolution, custom SVG existence and 24 dp drawing quality, inline currentColor SVG rendering, absence of glyph placeholders, SpatialUI bundle embedding, system-provided window glass, unchanged native ColorScheme roles, separate custom brandColors, tag registration, public-event wiring, native-control duplicates, structural region fills, renderer-invented CSS backgrounds, duplicate data-design-surface ownership, app-authored material fields, app-authored content borders, and design/debug-only controls. Verify getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor is rgb(218, 214, 211) and backgroundImage is none. Inspect rendered visual quality at default and minimum sizes; drive the bounded JSON-first patch loop.

loop.renderer_patch_exception: generic renderer defect or declared domain_visual only
